description: Use for "what is the ETH 15-minute market doing" and "which Kalshi 15-minute markets are open". Every Kalshi 15-minute up-or-down series — crypto, metals, energy, FX — with window status, YES price, close time, target price, what it settles on and the up rate over the last 96 windows, plus the same window on Polymarket (international) for BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP with each venue's settlement index and a graded record of the two venues on the same Bitcoin windows, and our Bitcoin top-of-hour strategy (v2 — the version our bot trades live, with its live and paper record). Pass series ("eth", "KXBTC15M") or asset_class.

limit.description: Max rows (default 30). Values above 40 are clamped to 40.

open_only.description: Only series with a window open right now (default false).

name: fifteen_min_board

our_model.description: Bitcoin only: our published top-of-hour strategy — version and status ("current version": it stays until it breaks), live_record (our own Kalshi account, after fees), paper record, last_call (the bot's newest decision for a closed window; source bot or paper), next decision time, and current_call: the bot's own :55 decision for the open window (PLAY = live, WATCH = paper).

rows.description: Kalshi 15-minute series: window status, YES price, close time, target, settlement source, up rate; for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP the same window on Polymarket (international, live book: price_source, as_of), and on the Bitcoin row venue_record — the two venues graded on the same windows.

tell_user.description: Show this sentence to the user first.

title: Kalshi 15-Minute Markets — every series, live
